synthesis:draft.headline: NSW1 five-minute RRP 531.84849 $/MWh at 2026-07-31 07:30 AEST (interval ending 2026-07-30T21:30:00Z).
summary: The peak five-minute RRP was 531.84849 $/MWh at interval ending 2026-07-30T21:30:00Z = 2026-07-31 07:30 AEST (evidence: price peak).
Fourteen 5-minute intervals met the analysis threshold of 300.0 $/MWh in the window.
Operational (half-hour) demand in the half-hour ending 2026-07-30T21:30:00Z (2026-07-31 07:30 AEST) was 11178.0 MW; the window maximum operational demand was 11382.0 MW.

The Directlink notice (Inter-regional transfer limit variation - Directlink all 3 cables - NSW region - 31/07/2026) gives 2026-07-27 07:00 AEST (2026-07-26T21:00:00Z), before the first 5-minute interval at or above the analysis threshold (interval ending 2026-07-30T11:10:00Z = 2026-07-30 21:10 AEST) and before the price extreme (interval ending 2026-07-30T21:30:00Z = 2026-07-31 07:30 AEST).

The Avon - Marulan line notice (Inter-regional transfer limit variation - Avon - Marulan 16 330 kV Line - NSW region - 01/08/2026) gives 2026-07-29 07:00 AEST (2026-07-28T21:00:00Z), before the first 5-minute interval at or above the analysis threshold (interval ending 2026-07-30T11:10:00Z = 2026-07-30 21:10 AEST) and before the price extreme (interval ending 2026-07-30T21:30:00Z = 2026-07-31 07:30 AEST).

numeric_claims.text: Number of 5-minute intervals at or above analysis threshold in window
Dispatch TOTALDEMAND (5-minute) at the five-minute peak interval
Net interchange at the five-minute peak interval (net flow into NSW1 = import)

possible_explanations.statement: The Directlink planned outage notice [c1] might have reduced import capability into NSW1 around 2026-07-30T21:30:00Z (2026-07-31 07:30 AEST) and could be relevant to the high five-minute RRP.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare Directlink-specific transfer limits and flow time series for the interval ending 2026-07-30T21:30:00Z (2026-07-31 07:30 AEST) with available import capability.

possible_explanations.statement: High operational demand in the half-hour ending 2026-07-30T21:30:00Z (11178.0 MW) and dispatch TOTALDEMAND 11432.7 MW at the five-minute peak might have tightened supply margins in NSW1.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare unit availability and offers for the half-hour ending 2026-07-30T21:30:00Z (2026-07-31 07:30 AEST) with actual dispatch and demand to see if available capacity was limited.

possible_explanations.statement: Large unit-level SCADA changes (for example ORABESS1 -413.7 MW [ev0929], ERARING +349.27 MW [ev0932], ERBESS +300.96 MW [ev0935]) might have altered local supply balance in the window around the event.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Inspect unit-level dispatch and outage records for the named units for intervals including 2026-07-30T21:30:00Z (2026-07-31 07:30 AEST) and the surrounding dispatch intervals.
